sections.section_title: Point on elliptic curve Fp check
sections.text_helper: Section 52.4.14 "Point on elliptic curve Fp check" in chapter 52 (Public key accelerator (PKA)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2467.
sections.section_content:
This operation checks whether a given point P(x,y) satisfies or not the curves over prime
fields equation y2=(x3+ax+b)modp, where a and b are elements of the curve.
The following table summarizes the operation instructions.
[Table 458. Point on elliptic curve Fp check]
